name: AlkemiEarn
fix_description: In liquidateBorrow, add require(msg.sender != targetAccount) to prevent self-liquidation. The function lacks this check, allowing attackers to self-liquidate and gain the 10% liquidation discount bonus via storage aliasing when the liquidator and borrower supply/borrow balances point to the same storage slots.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short multi-step self-liquidation chain using a flash loan: supply collateral, borrow against it, liquidate the attacker’s own debt due to flawed liquidation logic, then withdraw collateral and repay. While the PoC is compact, it requires understanding protocol-specific lending/liquidation behavior and why self-liquidation unlocks profit, making it more than a trivial access-control bug.
